key.name: toggle-panel
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that shows or hides the history panel.

key.name: history-size
key.description: How many unpinned entries to keep. Pinned entries are never evicted.

key.name: keep-after-reboot
key.description: Write history to disk so it survives logout. Pinned entries are always kept.

key.name: track-images
key.description: Record copied images and screenshots with a thumbnail preview.

key.name: ignore-password-managers
key.description: Skip clipboard content marked as sensitive by password managers.

key.name: app-blocklist
key.description: Window class names whose clipboard activity is never recorded.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.description: Images larger than this are not stored.

key.name: tray-binding-backup
key.description: The original value of org.gnome.shell.keybindings toggle-message-tray, saved before this extension took Super+V. Persisted so the binding can still be restored if the shell exits without calling disable(). Empty means nothing is currently stolen.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log clipboard events to the journal for troubleshooting.
